title: The Magicians
author: Lev Grossman
summary: A clever, unhappy Brooklyn teenager is admitted to a secret college of magic and discovers that his childhood favourite fantasy books describe a real world. Magic does not turn out to be a cure for being miserable.
readIf: you grew up on Narnia and Hogwarts and want a sharp, cynical, adult take on what comes next.
skipIf: you want warm, wish-fulfilment magic, since the lead is often unlikeable and the tone turns bleak.

pairings.reason: The cosy, wide-eyed version of the magic school this book deliberately pokes at.
A close circle of brilliant, self-absorbed students whose private world slowly turns toxic.
The original wardrobe-to-another-world story that Fillory is a knowing echo of.
